items.title: CPI, Cisco earnings, and more: What investors need to watch Wednesday
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host, Josh Lipton previews what investors should watch on Wednesday, August 12, including the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which will offer a fresh look at inflation and the health of the consumer. Cisco (CSCO) reports fiscal fourth-quarter results, while Bloomin' Brands (BLMN) also reports earnings.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Wednesday: CoreWeave, Super Micro, Cisco
items.summary: ↗️ CoreWeave (CRWV): Shares jumped over 15% in premarket trading after the cloud-computing company posted its fifth straight quarter of record revenue, fueled by sustained AI demand. ↗️ Super Micro Computer (SMCI): Shares jumped more than 7% premarket after the company reported a surging profit and sales nearly doubling in its fourth quarter.

items.title: Inflation Figures, Earnings: What to Watch the Rest of the Week
items.summary: Today Inflation data: Consumer price index for July, 8:30 a.m. ET Other data: EIA petroleum status report, Treasury budget  Bond auctions: 10-year Treasury note Earnings: Cisco Systems, Stubhub, Coherent, Air Canada Thursday Economic data: Producer price index for July, Jobless claims, EIA natural-gas storage report Earnings: Applied Materials, Tapestry Federal Reserve speakers: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, one of three Fed regional bank heads to dissent from last month’s rate decision.

items.title: Here’s How Much Traders Expect Cisco Stock to Move After Earnings
items.summary: Cisco is set to post earnings after the closing bell Wednesday, with traders anticipating a move that could bring the stock back near its June highs.

items.title: Arista Networks Stock Is Waiting On Parts, Not Orders
items.summary: Arista keeps raising its revenue outlook as it locks up components, which makes its supply agreements the real driver of the upside case.

items.title: Is Cisco Systems Stock Poised for New Highs as Q4 Earnings Approach?
items.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) is set to report its fiscal fourth-quarter results after the closing bell on Wednesday, Aug. 12, putting the networking giant back in the spotlight as investors assess whether its impressive momentum can continue.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks Stock Ran On A Threat That Management Had Already Named
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks had described the AI attack problem, raised its long-term target and bought an observability platform before the stock repriced.
